entities.name: Antiochus Chuzon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antiochus Chuzon, called "the Elder" to distinguish him from his nephew, was a high official of the Eastern Roman Empire, praetorian prefect of the East and consul, who was a key figure in the compilation of the Codex Theodosianus.
